turns.learner: Hi! Can we learn word order (subject + verb + object) today?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Good topic. In a simple English sentence, the order is: subject (who) + verb (action) + object (what). Place or time comes at the end.

Example: Sam plays football on Fridays.

Your turn. Put the words in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
